name: Sublime Equestrian
text: While you're mounted upon your unicorn, all allies in a 10-foot emanation around your unicorn gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons and reduce the DC of the flat check to recover from persistent damage to 13 (or to 8 with an assisted recovery). Any Frightened ally that ends its turn in the aura reduces its frightened condition by 2 instead of 1.
